core_meaning.primary_meaning: Durrani is a Pashto-origin name meaning “Pearl”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Pashto word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Durrani corresponds to the Pashto form دراني (Pashto Durrānī). Its core sense is pearl, precious stone. Durrānī, the name of the Pashtun royal clan of the Durrani Empire, from durr ('pearl'). The source record's gloss 'Pearl' is a reasonable rendering. The source record classified it as Arabic, which is incorrect.

arabic.name: دراني
arabic.long_meaning: Durrani (دراني) اسم مأخوذ من اللغة غير محددة، ومعناه الأساسي اللؤلؤة، الجوهرة، الدرة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم في المجتمعات المسلمة ويختلف استعماله بحسب السياق اللغوي.
